title: Audio Ops — Overview
description: Real-time inference results, training metrics, and stream health

panels.title: Active Streams
panels.description: Number of RTSP streams currently being processed

targets.query:
from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "active")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value == 1)
  |> distinct(column: "stream_id")
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "active_streams")

panels.title: Inferences / min
panels.description: Inference throughput in the last minute

targets.query:
from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^inference_/ or r._measurement =~ /^stream_/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confidence")
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "inference_count")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^inference_/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confidence")
  |> mean()
  |> yield(name: "avg_confidence")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(inference_|stream_)/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rms")
  |> mean()
  |> yield(name: "avg_rms")

panels.title: Inference Confidence Over Time — by Task

targets.query:
from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(inference_|stream_)/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confidence")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.task }))
  |> yield(name: "confidence_by_task")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^inference_/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "label")
  |> group(columns: ["_value"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ _field: r._value, _value: float(v: r._value) }))
  |> yield(name: "label_distribution")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(inference_|stream_)/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.stream_id }))
  |> yield(name: "rms_by_stream")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^inference_/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confidence" or r._field == "label" or r._field == "rms")
  |> pivot(rowKey:["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "task", "model", "source_type", "stream_id", "confidence", "label", "rms"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
  |> yield(name: "latest_inferences")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^training_/ and not (r._measurement =~ /_batch$/))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "train_loss" or r._field == "val_loss")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.task + "/" + r._field }))
  |> yield(name: "training_loss")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^training_/ and not (r._measurement =~ /_batch$/))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "val_acc" or r._field == "train_acc")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.task + "/" + r._field }))
  |> yield(name: "accuracy")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^training_/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "learning_rate")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.task + "/lr" }))
  |> yield(name: "lr")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /_batch$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "loss")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.task + "/batch_loss" }))
  |> yield(name: "batch_loss")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inference_speech_to_text")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "word_count")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "word_count")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "inference_speech_to_text")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "transcript")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> yield(name: "transcripts")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "frames_processed")
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.stream_id + "/fps" }))
  |> yield(name: "frame_rate")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ingest_queue_depth")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "queue_depth")
